profile.headline: Director of Engineering, Blade AI at Inertia Systems
profile.summary: Programmer: mainly C# and C/C++. Video, Social Media and IOT

positions.title: Owner / Software Architect
positions.description:
Independent software architecture, engineering, and consulting across industrial IoT, embedded systems, distributed applications, cloud infrastructure, and AI. I design and build end-to-end solutions, from field devices and sensor networks to data pipelines, APIs, and user interfaces.
SOFTWARE & ARCHITECTURE
C#, .NET, Blazor, Python, C++, JavaScript; Clean Architecture, CQRS, MediatR, REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous processing, and event-driven systems. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, MySQL, and InfluxDB. Authentication, OAuth, Entra ID, and role-based access control.
INDUSTRIAL IoT & AUTOMATION
Remote telemetry, data acquisition, monitoring, and control for industrial equipment. Microcontroller firmware; LoRa/RFM69 and cellular communications; MQTT, RabbitMQ, and Node-RED. Sensor integration, relay control, voltage monitoring, alerting, and time-series analytics. Environmental data collection for agricultural prediction models.
AI & AGENTIC ENGINEERING
AI-assisted development and coding agents for implementation, refactoring, testing, and code review. Agentic workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool integrations, and LLM-powered applications and automation.
CLOUD & SYSTEMS
Docker, Linux, Windows Server, IIS, Nginx, CI/CD, deployment automation, and self-hosted/cloud infrastructure. Background in multithreaded real-time systems, scientific and pharmaceutical software, enterprise integration, and legacy modernization.
Focus: practical solutions, maintainable architecture, reliability, and bridging hardware and software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Social Media API integration for video upload to Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Google+, LinkedIn, Vimeo, Brightcove, Sprinklr ( C# )
Successfully managed an international group of engineers as well as a local team. 
Trained teams of engineers on the technicalities of video and audio formats, codec, containers and techniques. 
Video transcoding for broadcast, most video containers and codecs. ( C++ )

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a windows DNA architecture web application using ASP, COM+ and Oracle. COM objects all programmed in C++ using STL, ATL and ADO. 
Used ISAPI extensions to implement streaming of data through COM filters from an Oracle database 
Implemented an ACL type security system in COM and ASP for a web application 
Coded a multithreaded cross-platform server farm using XML-RPC (SOAP) and SQL (Oracle) using open source techniques and libraries.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java, Linux, Oracle, Zebra (ZCL), MDL molecular file format conversion, Samba web accessible printing 
Responsible for the design and implementation of cheminformatics systems allowing chemists control over sample registration using server side Java with a web interface running on Linux and an Oracle backend using MDL HViews.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Worked on the kiosks for the superbowl ( Java  on SUN )
Programmed a reusable Java component that implements multipart MIME uploading over HTTP. 
Developed distributed print capabilities for a Java based informational kiosk deployed by the City of San Diego. 
Wrote Java servlets and applets that interact with an Oracle database through JDBC. 
Utilized JavaScript, DHTML and frames to create highly interactive thin client interfaces for Intranet applications. 
Led project to completely redesign the corporate Internet and Intranet site including graphics, navigation, user interface, graceful degradation to lower browser versions, and dynamically generated HTML.
